content: Advance M0130/W0135 with a host-independent filesystem cache publication layer. Persist portable and device-bound payloads with atomic replacement, envelope integrity checks, corruption cleanup, and explicit device invalidation while preserving the existing in-memory catalog and leaving Vulkan pipeline execution and cross-process stampede control open.

Filesystem entries use a deterministic two-word FNV-1a filename plus an envelope carrying the complete canonical key, cache mode, payload length, and integrity digest. Publish writes a process-unique temporary file, fsyncs it, atomically renames it, and never treats a partial or mismatched entry as a hit.

Content revision 4959da6 adds CacheFileStore with process-local serialization, deterministic entry tokens, complete-key/mode/length/digest envelopes, fsync plus atomic rename, corruption cleanup, and device-bound invalidation. Cache regressions cover round trips, replacement, truncation, equal-length mutation, input bounds, and temporary-file cleanup.

The focused cache test passed and the full Vulkan CTest passed 88/88. W0135 remains Active because CacheCatalog/filesystem residency integration, cross-process stampede control, opaque VkPipelineCache, pipeline creation, warm-launch traces, and pipeline-bound driver invalidation remain open.
